'''Falch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] of the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Felix Iresso]] along with [[Cawelyn]], [[Marren Dask]], [[Tsalesh]], [[Kree]], [[Lavik]] and [[Zaun]]. Together they assisted the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] in defeating the [[White Maw]] pirate [[Valon (pirate)|Valon]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Falch appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on Hoth.
